# Breezy Risk Advisors

> Insurance strategy, technology, and operations advisory. Works with investors, carriers, MGAs, and insurtechs. Fee-based. No policies sold. No commissions earned.

Breezy Risk Advisors is an independent advisory practice founded by Joerg Proeve. The firm advises investors, carriers, MGAs, and insurtechs on insurance strategy, technology, and operations. Breezy Risk Advisors does not sell insurance, place policies, or earn commissions.

## Advisory Focus

### Investor Advisory
Advises private equity and venture capital investors evaluating insurance platforms, MGAs, and insurtech opportunities. Focus areas include insurance due diligence, MGA capacity economics, platform operations, and deal screening.

### AI Liability & Emerging Risk
Analysis and advisory on AI liability insurance, emerging risk pricing, and the measurement infrastructure behind new coverage lines. Published in Insurance Thought Leadership on AI liability pricing and measurement gaps.

### Carrier & Insurtech Strategy
Advises carriers, MGAs, and insurtechs on technology strategy, operating model design, and underwriting operations. Focus areas include carrier technology portfolio governance, MGA product and distribution architecture, and cyber insurance market structure.

## Who Breezy Risk Advisors Serves

- Investors evaluating insurance technology, MGA platforms, or insurtech opportunities.
- Insurance carriers seeking advisory on technology strategy, operating model, and emerging risks.
- MGAs and insurtechs working on product design, capacity strategy, and underwriting operations.

Breezy Risk Advisors is not a broker. It is an independent, fee-based advisory practice.

## The Founder

Joerg Proeve has spent his career on both sides of the insurance operating model — inside carriers and building MGAs. At Chubb, he worked in corporate strategy and then post-merger integration after the $28B ACE-Chubb merger, consolidating the two legacy organizations and introducing a new performance reporting framework across 54 countries. At CNA, he designed the governance framework for its $325M technology portfolio. He served as COO of BOXX Insurance, a cyber MGA acquired by Zurich, building operations and scaling distribution across all 50 states. He co-founded Parachute Insurance, a parametric MGA for hurricane risk. He holds an MSc in Electrical Engineering from KIT (Germany), an MBA from London Business School, and started his career in cybersecurity at Siemens.

- "Insurers Struggle to Price AI Liability Coverage" — Insurance Thought Leadership, September 2026.

## Key Articles

- [AI Liability: The Insurance Arrived Before the Loss Model](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/ai-liability-arrived-before-the-loss-model/) - Three approaches are emerging to price AI liability without historical loss data.
- [The Two-Track MGA Market](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/the-two-track-mga-market/) - The MGA market is splitting into platform plays and capacity-first shops. Investors and carriers are choosing sides.
- ["Buy and Preserve" Is Not a Platform](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/buy-and-preserve-is-not-a-platform/) - Why aggregating MGAs without integrating operations does not produce a platform.
- [Buy, Build, or Wait](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/buy-build-or-wait/) - Three carrier strategies for AI underwriting, and what each one actually requires.
- [The Cost of Disassembly](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/the-cost-of-disassembly/) - The disassembled insurance value chain consumes 35 cents of every premium dollar before a single claim is paid.
- [Every Carrier Wants Its Own Cyber MGA](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/every-carrier-wants-its-own-cyber-mga/) - Six deals in thirty months paired global balance sheets with cyber underwriting platforms.
- [Everything Scarce in Insurance Is Becoming Abundant. Except Three Things.](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/everything-scarce-becoming-abundant/) - How information, technology, and capital stopped being scarce, and who owns the scarcities that remain.
- [Insuring AI Liability Without Measuring the Risks](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/ai-liability-measurement-gap/) - The first cohort of AI liability writers is live. The measurement infrastructure underneath them is not.
- [What Gets Lost in the MGA Assembly Line](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/mga-assembly-line/) - $125 billion in premium flows through MGAs and programs. Nobody owns the coordination.
- [What RPA Should Have Taught P&C Carriers About AI](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/rpa-lessons-for-ai/) - Carriers spent a decade on RPA. The lessons apply directly to the current AI wave.
- [Buy or Cede: What Two Mega-Deals Reveal About Cyber Underwriting](https://breezyrisk.com/insights/buy-or-cede/) - Zurich paid $10.9B for Beazley. Allianz handed its cyber book to Coalition. Two opposite strategies, one admission.
